svg.title: How one EngineCore step moves requests through queues
svg.desc: The input thread decodes requests from ZMQ into input_queue. Each step, run_busy_loop drains input_queue into the scheduler waiting queue. schedule gives tokens to running requests first, then admits waiting requests from the front while the token budget lasts. If KV blocks run out, a running request is preempted back to the front of waiting. The step plan goes to the worker, update_from_output records the sampled tokens and removes finished requests from running, and the outputs go through output_queue to the output thread.

g.text: RUN_BUSY_LOOP() REPEATS ① – ⑥ EVERY STEP · FINISHED REQUESTS LEAVE RUNNING AT ⑤
